notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature for each opponent that cannot be blocked by that opponent.
easyPrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
description:
Cast Mirrorweave by paying {2}{W/U}{W/U}, causing each creature you control to become a copy of Virulent Silencer until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to each opponent using any nontoken creature you control. Each creature you control triggers, giving each opponent two poison counters.
The opponents will lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
